description.zh: 云服务分类。例如：Redis有`kvstore_standard`（标准版）、`kvstore_sharding`（集群版）和`kvstore_splitrw`（读写分离版）等。
description.en: The category of the Alibaba Cloud service. For example, Redis has `kvstore_standard` (Standard Edition), `kvstore_sharding` (Cluster Edition), and `kvstore_splitrw` (read/write splitting Edition).

description.zh: 报警黑名单策略的ID列表。
description.en: The IDs of the alert blacklist policies.

description.zh:
报警黑名单策略中的实例ID列表。

N的取值范围：0~10。
description.en:
The instance IDs in the alert blacklist policy.

Valid values of N: 0 to 10.

description.zh:
报警黑名单策略的启用状态。取值：

- true：启用。
- false：禁用。
description.en:
The status of the alert blacklist policy. Valid values:

- true: enabled.
- false: disabled.

description.zh:
报警黑名单策略名称。

该参数支持模糊查询。
description.en:
The name of the alert blacklist policy.

This parameter supports fuzzy match.

description.zh:
云服务的数据命名空间。

关于云服务的命名空间，请参见[云服务监控项](~~163515~~)。
description.en:
The namespace of the Alibaba Cloud service.

For information about the namespaces of Alibaba Cloud services, see [Cloud service metrics](~~163515~~).

description.zh:
查询结果按时间的排序方式。取值：

- DESC（默认值）：降序。

- ASC：升序。
description.en:
The order in which the query results are sorted by time. Valid values:

- DESC (default): descending order.

- ASC: ascending order.

The current page number.

Default value: 1.

description.zh:
每页显示的记录条数。

默认值：10。
description.en:
The number of entries per page.

Default value: 10.

description.zh:
报警黑名单策略的生效范围。取值：

- USER：报警黑名单策略仅在当前阿里云账号中生效。

- GROUP：报警黑名单策略在指定应用分组中生效。
description.en:
The effective scope of the alert blacklist policy. Valid values:

- USER: The alert blacklist policy takes effect only within the current Alibaba Cloud account.

- GROUP: The alert blacklist policy takes effect within the specified application groups.
